messages:
Leah Gomez: Heads-up: Brooklyn Night LLM Meetup next Thu 6pm. Small footprint: 1 demo table, 1 banner, limited power. Need final speaker list, swag drop plan, and lead routing by EOD Tue.

Marcus Lee: I can own lead routing. Plan: QR -> short Google Form -> Zap to Sales-inbound Slack. Include interest tags (API/Dedicated/Private).

Nora Patel: Speakers: 4 confirmed (Incl. 1 community lightning). Requesting 2-line bio + slide by Wed noon. I'll DM folks.

Samir Gupta: Swag: 80 tees, 60 enamel pins, 150 stickers. Courier can deliver day-of 2pm. Who's meeting them?

OpsBot: dock_booking: confirmed for 2pm-3pm at 78 Bedford Ave loading zone. Driver to check in on arrival channel.

PrintVendor: Noted. We'll palletize tees and pins, label "BK NIGHT - REDWOOD". Please provide onsite contact for signature.

Ivy (events): Onsite contact: Marcus (cell 917-555-0244). AV: venue has 1 mic, no ethernet. Bring hotspot + power strip.

Marcus Lee: I'll bring a mobile hotspot and 2 power strips. Also a short HDMI dongle.

Leah Gomez: Run-of-show draft:
```
18:00 doors
18:15 Intro (Leah) 5m
18:22 Product demo (Samir) 12m
18:36 Lightning (community) 6m
18:44 Q&A + networking at booth
```
Speakers, confirm slides + bio by Wed noon.

Nora Patel: Also want a quick lead opt-in checkbox for EU attendees (GDPR). Marcus can you add?

Marcus Lee: Will add GDPR consent and utm params. Sharing form link by Tue 5pm.

Leah Gomez: Photographer? Would be great for social. Approve up to $120.

Ivy (events): OK to book for 45 minutes (setup + first talks). I'll add to budget.

Samir Gupta: Please note swag can't be left on stage per venue. Keep at demo table.

Leah Gomez: Booth shifts proposal:
```
6:00-7:00pm Leah + Marcus (setup, demos)
7:00-8:00pm Nora + Samir (lead capture, teardown)
```
Reply :thumbsup: if you can take your slot.

Marcus Lee: :thumbsup: I'll take 6-7.

Nora Patel: :thumbsup: taking 7-8 and will chase slides.

Leah Gomez: Thanks team. Final checklist before EOD Tue: slides+bios, form live, dock confirmed, photographer booked. Ping me for blockers. :sparkles:
